subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-21
html:
SE Ranking stayed authenticated for a 5th straight session. A fresh full pull on the FOCUS cluster (MCP-integration keywords) found nothing new — connector matrix and comparison hub are both fully built out, and every remaining gap (Meta Ads, HubSpot, Stripe, Shopify, Mailchimp MCP) is still gated on an overdue catalog.ts connector. The destinations-comparison-page path is now also conclusively closed: Excel, Snowflake, and Redshift do have real "alternative" search demand, but all three destinations are still coming_soon/waitlist in the product itself — building a comparison page for any of them would overclaim a feature that doesn't exist yet, so none were built. Instead, re-auditing the site's own sitemap.ts (last touched 2026-09-10) turned up a real, previously unflagged bug: it was stamping every destination, comparison, connector, and services page with the same blanket date regardless of when that page actually changed.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
All 33 dynamic URLs: /destinations/*, /compare/*, /connect/*, /services/*Fixed sitemap.xml's <lastmod> dates, which were hardcoded to a single July 4 date for every one of these pages no matter what changed since. Each page already tracks its own real last-changed date for its on-page schema (e.g. the Google Sheets and Tableau destination pages, updated in September) — the sitemap now reads that same date instead of a stale placeholder, so it no longer understates how fresh recently-updated pages are (or, on one comparison page, overstates it).N/A — indexation/technical-SEO correctness fix, no new keyword targetedaskarlo.app/sitemap.xml — search for /destinations/google_sheets or /compare/windsor-ai-vs-arlo and compare the lastmod date to that page's own visible "last updated" info

Rankings/backlinks (fresh pull): avg position still flat at 100 (0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked) every day this week — 12th week unchanged. Backlinks holding at 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, same as every pulse since 2026-09-10. catalog.ts re-checked: all 8 gated connectors remain coming_soon and overdue, none flipped live.

Next: Both content engines (the MCP-integration keyword cluster and the destinations-comparison pages) are genuinely exhausted for now — the next real opportunity is either a catalog.ts connector shipping (unlocks a new connector-matrix page) or a destination flipping from coming-soon to live/beta (unlocks a new comparison page). Everything else that could move rankings or backlinks — off-page directory listings, Google Search Console sitemap submission — remains a human-gated decision, unchanged.
